title: Weekly serving cadence — agenda & action tracker
content:
Meeting: Weekly serving cadence (runtime + infra + console)
Date: Thu 2026-03-12, 10:00–10:45 PT
Location: Zoom / #serving-runtime (Slack)
Lead: Harper Chen
Attendees (target): Harper, Ravi, Marta, Anika, SRE on-call (TBD), PM (optional)

Purpose:
- Rapidly align on regressions, runway (capacity/cost), and console pain points affecting customers.
- Surface one rollout/experiment that needs cross-team input.
- Track concrete action items and owners.

Pre-reads (skim before meeting):
- P50/P95 latency trend (last 7d) — console dashboard 'runtime/latency'
- Incident summary: 2026-03-09 model-fallback spike (linked)
- PR #2014: KV cache change (high-level notes in PR)

Agenda (45m):
1) Quick status (10m) — rapid bullets from each discipline (infra / runtime / console)
   - Infra (Ravi): capacity headroom, upcoming maintenance windows.
   - Runtime (Marta): notable errors, memory pressure, batching anomalies.
   - Console (Harper): dashboard gaps called out by support tickets.
   - SRE: on-call observations (if present)

2) Customer-impact items (10m) — prioritize:
   - Model fallback spike review (3m): root cause hypothesis and short-term mitigation (roll back, limiters).
   - High cost path: small-input high-latency jobs hitting dedicated pools — decide throttling policy.

3) Rollout checkpoint (10m) — PR #2014 KV cache change
   - Rollout window: staging -> canary -> prod (Marta to present rollout plan)
   - Metrics to watch: request success, p95, cache hit ratio, token-per-second throughput

4) Console follow-ups & observability gaps (7m)
   - Missing per-route cost breakdown for Dedicated customers (Harper): action item to prototype table in dashboard.
   - Tracing: sampling is inconsistent for short-lived requests — proposal to reduce sampling for <50ms.

5) Action item rundown + parking lot (8m)

Notes to self / prep bullets (Harper):
- Bring specific logs from 2026-03-09 incident (search: fallback * model variant) — keep top 3 examples
- Remind Marta to include rollback playbook link in PR description
- Ask Ravi about weekend autoscaler warmup settings (are min replicas >0 for Dedicated?)
- Ask SRE to confirm if quota throttles were hit for that customer on 2026-03-09

Metrics I want surfaced live (pin these in console slides):
- P50, P95, P99 latency (7d delta) — runtime/latency
- Error rate (5xx) by model variant and region
- Queue depth / concurrency by pool type (hosted vs dedicated)
- KV cache hit rate (recent 24h)
- Token/Sec throughput (per-GPU and aggregate)

Open questions / hypothesis list (parking lot):
- Did the fallback spike correlate with aggressive batching thresholds? (Hypothesis: long tail from merged small requests)
- Are any customers on dedicated pools using unexpected max-sequence lengths? Need to correlate with token billing anomalies.
- Console: does the current sampling interval hide bursty errors? Does increasing retention help?

Action items (tracking) — numbered for clarity:
1) Marta: Finalize KV cache rollout plan and add rollback steps to PR #2014. Due: 2026-03-13. Status: in progress. Linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2014
2) Ravi: Confirm Dedicated autoscaler min/scale settings and report weekend warmup doc. Due: 2026-03-15. Status: todo.
3) Harper: Prototype per-route cost table mock in console (deck slide + screen grab). Due: 2026-03-19. Status: todo. Linked: linear INF-4528
4) SRE (on-call): Extract and paste 3 representative logs from 2026-03-09 fallback incident to the meeting thread. Due: 2026-03-12 EOD. Status: requested.
5) Anika: Run quick token-length audit for top 5 Dedicated customers and flag any > 8k seqs. Due: 2026-03-16. Status: todo.
6) Harper + Ravi: Draft short throttling policy (hosted small-input rate limits) and present for quick vote next week. Due: 2026-03-19. Status: draft

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy into Slack thread):
- Summary (1–2 lines): what changed, immediate mitigations, who owns follow-ups.
- Action items with owners + due dates (copy exact bullets from tracker).
- Links: incident logs, PRs, dashboard links.

1:1 prep notes (Harper with Marta, 30m later) — quick topics:
- Career check-in: ask about growth areas (inference perf, kernel optimization)
- Blockers on KV work (need more infra slots? test harness?)
- Ask for 2 small wins we can ship next sprint to reduce regressions (Marta to propose)

Voice / tone reminders (personal scratchpad):
- Keep meeting fast; mic-drop questions: "Is this customer-impacting?" and "Can we fix this in <48h?"
- If debate >5m: move to async and assign an owner

Bookmarks / quick links (for meeting thread):
- Slack: #serving-runtime
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2014
- Linear: https://linear.app/INF/issue/INF-4528
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/serving-runtime-oncall

Parking lot (move to next week's agenda if not resolved):
- Console: add per-customer token-level billing drill-down (larger project)
- Investigate adaptive batch sizing heuristics for small inputs

End of notes — will tidy into meeting thread after the sync.

Quick status line (for standup post-meeting):
- KV cache rollout on track (Marta) / Dedicated autoscaler check (Ravi) / Console mock for costs (Harper)
